ANbll1-malS ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT& DECLARATIONOFCOVENANTSANDRESTRICTIONS THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT&DECLARATION OF COVENANTS AND RESTRICTIONS (this “Agreement"), made as of the S day of June, 2018, by and between by and between ED 97 OWNER, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with offices c/o Dalan Management, 134 West 25th Street, 5th Floor, New York, New York 10001, ("Lower Parcel Owner") and 230 West 97th Street, LLC, as to an undivided fifty (50%) percent tenant in common interst, and 230 West 97th Street Successor, LLC, as to an undivided fifty (50%) percent tenant in cmmon interest, both located c/o AAG Management Inc., 421 Seventh Avenue, 15th floor, New York, New York 10001 (collectively, the “Air Parcel Owner")(Lower Parcel Owner or Air Parcel Owner, each, an “Owner” and collectively, "Owners"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Lower Parcel Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 230 West 97th Street, New York, New York (the "Lot 44 Land"), designated as Lot 44 in Block 1868 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, hereto; the buildings and improvements on the Lot 44 Land, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein called collectively the “Lot 44 Building"; the Lot 44 Land and the Lot 44 Building, collectively, the “Lot 44 Parcel") WHEREAS, immediately after recording this Agreement, Lower Parcel Owner will subdivide the Lot 44 Parcel into two parcels of land constituting two separate tax lots consisting of a parcel below a limiting plane (the “Limiting Plane") located at a height which is the lesser of: (i) five hundred (500') feet above the level of the sidewalk abutting the entrance to the Lot 44 Building utilizing the Datum (as defined herein) as zero elevation as determined by an elevation survey or (i) the highest elevation permitted by the Department of Finance of the City of New York for the commencement height of the lower horizontal plane of an upper air fee parcel (the "Lower Parcel") as, more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto, and a parcel above the Limiting Plane (the “Air Parcel"), to which will be transferred the Excess Development Rights (hereafter defined), more particularly described in Exhibit C annexed hereto; WHEREAS, upon completion of the subdivision, the fee for the Air Parcel and the Excess Development Rights (as hereafter defined) will be transferred and conveyed to Air Parcel Owner or its designee, and, upon such transfer and conveyance, Air Parcel Owner or its designee shall be the owner of (a) fee simple title to the Air Parcel, and (b) the Excess Development Rights; WHEREAS, the Lot 44 Building contain less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereafter defined), than is now available for use on the Lot 44 Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that, after taking into account the floor area currently used by the Lot 44 Buildings and an additional 2,290 square feet of floor area to be retained by Owner, Excess Development Rights are available for transfer to and utilization on another tax lot that is part of the same zoning lot as the Lot 44 Land;
